snippet.title: Layers of Bust Trailer
snippet.description:
A lonely candle suddenly inhabits a spirit: a beautiful and curvaceous woman. With the ability to transform and slow down time, she uses her new body to escape the dangerous dungeon.

Coming soon to Steam and Itch! Wishlist now!
